messages:
jamie: DeployBot queued release v1.12.0 for services: api, runtime, router, console. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. There's an API schema tweak that requires a runtime compat check. tagging @sanjay @lisa @mike_r

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Release v1.12.0 scheduled. Canary plan: router 10% -> 30% over 15m, api staged 5% -> 25%. Health checks: 5xx < 0.5% and p95 < 600ms. Rollout config suggests pin: runtime=1.5.3

sanjay: Heads up — runtime v1.5.3 includes the new compat shim but also a kv-sync change. I'd prefer pinning to 1.5.2 for safety unless we validate kv-sync in canary pool.

lisa: Console has a label tweak for the new API field; non-breaking. I'll hold console change until after api+runtime canary is stable.

mike_r: Router needs a small header-based fallback rule for this release. We'll do a rolling restart, coordinate so router doesn't flip canary traffic during restart.

olivia: Quick question — what's the rollback plan if api canary shows errors? Who triggers and which services get rolled back?

jamie: Runbook: oncall triggers rollback via ./ops/rollback.sh <service> <version>. Default action: rollback API only and pause other rollouts. Oncall is @mike_r for this window. Confirm manual approval for full rollback to avoid cascading.

runtime-bot: runtime-health: canary started on pool-3. Metrics: mem=72% cpu=45% initial checks passed.

deploy-bot: router canary at 10% — no errors. api canary at 5% — saw short 500 spike at +3m (one host), investigating.

sanjay: tailing logs now:
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api -c api --since=10m | grep "ERROR" | head -20
```
sample: "WARN [request-id=abc123] upstream timeout -> 502" looks like transient gateway flap.

lisa: I'll postpone console deploy until we confirm api runtime stable. No console changes during canary to reduce noise.

jamie: Decision: pin runtime to 1.5.2 for this rollout. Proceeding with api v2.4.0 (no DB migration). Canary schedule: 10% for 10m, 25% for 20m, then 100% with 15m observation. Abort criteria: any 5xx > 0.8% or p95 > 700ms -> immediate rollback.

mike_r: :thumbsup: I've added the maintenance block to calendar. Infra will keep extra capacity on standby.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% complete. Next checkpoint in 20m. Release notes draft:
- API: add optional `client_context` field (backwards compatible)
- Runtime: perf optimizations and small GC tune
- Router: header-based fallback routing
- Console: UI label polish (deferred to post-rollout)

olivia: Oncall here — I'll monitor SLO dashboard and logs. If threshold breached I'll call rollback and ping the channel.

jamie: Thanks team. If canary stays green we proceed to full rollout at +1h. Keep pings in this thread and annotate any manual holds with reason. :eyes:
